scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @maze/shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,server,client "npm run dev --workspace @maze/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @maze/server" "npm run dev --workspace @maze/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @maze/shared && npm run build --workspace @maze/server && npm run build --workspace @maze/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @maze/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --project tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @maze/shared && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/shared/src/*.test.ts apps/server/src/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
